'''Revised Dagobah''' is the 17th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in December 1999. It is the white-border Revised Unlimited reprint of [[Dagobah Limited]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

It reprints the 180-card Limited pool with Special Edition–era revised text. The card list is below.

== Packaging ==
Sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 30-pack boxes. Each box included a fold-out Rules Supplement.<ref name="encyc" />

Total ability of 6 or more is required for opponent to draw battle destiny.

Attempt when apprentice is present at the end of your turn and none of your cards participated in battles, Force drains or Jedi Tests during that turn. Draw training destiny. If destiny + apprentice's ability &gt; 14, test completed. Place on apprentice. You may subtract 1 from each of opponent's destiny draws.
|-

Apprentice: Your non-droid, non-Jedi character of lesser ability than mentor. Each time you complete any Jedi Test, you may exchange one card in hand for one Jedi Test in your Lost Pile.
|-

Whenever you are about to draw a card for destiny, you may instead use the upside-down card (which remains on apprentice for re-use).
